timingBasis: startedAt records the formal AST coverage pass; manual preparation and initial source reading began earlier in the same uninterrupted reviewer task.
methods: Fresh independent review of the current frozen snapshot. No prior audit result was used as passing evidence. No Git history, sibling/archive source, personal Codex home, or real account credentials was read.

All scoped implementation files were read as full source. Cross-file reasoning followed dispatch policy, validation, native writes, beforeWrite owner/activity fences, receipt delivery classification, retained resources, disconnect/close paths, persistence and restart behavior.

All 171 scoped TS/JS files were parsed and recursively traversed with the installed rolldown TypeScript/JavaScript AST parser. Recorded function/method entries, control branches, awaited calls, catch bodies, call inventory and test declarations were inspected. Test assertion matcher inventories were also inspected. This is structural review, not a claim of manual line-by-line reading of every test.

The README was read as declared contracts and evidence limitations, not as proof that previous tests passed. The model fixture was parsed and manually inspected. Ignored/untracked runtime products outside the frozen names were not silently added to scope.

Targeted execution used the pinned Node 24.22.1 runtime and official CLI 0.164.0 only. Native tests used fresh .work homes and the sanitized nativeTestEnvironment with non-loopback HTTP(S)/ALL_PROXY blocked at 127.0.0.1:9 and no inherited account/provider credentials.
Final scripts/snapshot.mjs inventory/digest and independent per-file hashes matched the frozen snapshot after the focused tests. No source/configuration/test changes were made.
reviewedFlows: Provider registry identity, equal model IDs across providers, reasoning/default effort, dedicated bounded default probes, account identity while API provider is default, owner-scoped device login and logout.
Project resolution under native identity, canonical managed creation, trust edits, configured root/environment authority and permissions/approval subset validation.
Cloud preflight rejection without PTY/activity poisoning, CLI terminal barriers and proven subtree cleanup, automatic refresh request, in-flight worker response draining and restart signalling.
HTTP cookie/CSRF/origin/host checks, password/TOTP/recovery state, WS lease ownership, worker channel revocation, late request/response races and bounded transport budgets.
Automation scheduling/timezone arithmetic, revisioned immutable run specifications, due windows, restart uncertainty, manual run identity, stop and history-based positive reconciliation.

Durable operation receipts and capacity commitments, accepted/unknown/not_sent semantics, replay identity, retention generations, workspace witness/hash/root/inode bindings and acknowledgement ordering.
History and timeline hydration authority, stale reads and owner fencing, queue/goal/steer/review/fork/revert continuity, attachment retention and actual model modality validation.
Standalone processes and shell terminals, Windows owned Job Object proof, Linux descendant controller, cleanup failure/timeout behavior and output retention.
MCP configuration merging, fresh discovery/schema validation, resource/template identities, result ownership, OAuth lifecycle and asynchronous subscription cleanup.

Realtime sequencing/queues/stop proof, Guardian denied-action capabilities, predictions expiry and revision invalidation, native organization APIs, extensions/import/sharing/feedback, diagnostic/resource helpers and remote executor/account-control boundaries.

targetedValidation.evidence: Real CLI process exit and interactive PTY; shared synthetic ChatGPT identity when API provider is default; simultaneous equal model IDs route to separate loopback providers and resume after catalog replacement.

Real authenticated HTTP/WS gateway/worker/CLI chain; managed writable project; unauthenticated Cloud not_sent leaves local work available; loopback turns/history/receipts, replay without duplicate provider request, interrupt and verified cleanup.

testedHypotheses.hypothesis: Repeated base64 validation regular expression might fail at allowed large input sizes.
testedHypotheses.result: Not reproduced under pinned Node: valid 65,536, 131,072, 262,144 and 1,048,576 byte encodings matched, including a cold 1 MiB input. No finding inferred.

boundaries: This is the assigned runtime/core/gateway audit, not the root audit of protocol generation, UI, native launcher implementation, packaging or deployment.
No full-repository test suite, build/release publication or online account action was performed. Passing targeted tests do not stand in for the separately gated final full suite.

Actual browser rendering/IME/accessibility, authenticated paid Cloud submission, real device-code login, commercial provider inference, live external MCP/OAuth, provider realtime audio and remote account pairing were not exercised.
Current execution host is Windows. Linux implementation was statically reviewed; no new Linux cross-UID/systemd/native permissions integration was run in this scope.

Tests other than the explicitly listed full-text cases received AST/control/assertion-structure review and cross-file implementation review, not a claim that each test line was manually read or every test executed.
